_about: F. H. Bradley (1846-1924), raw IA OCR: Ethical Studies (the 1876 first edition in Stechert's 1904 anastatic reprint), The Principles of Logic (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, 1883), and Appearance and Reality, 2nd ed., revised, with an appendix (London: Swan Sonnenschein, 1908). All published before 1930, so US public domain. Not to be confused with A. C. Bradley, his brother, editor of Green's Prolegomena. Added in round ba: Essays on Truth and Reality (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1914; raw IA OCR, clean 0.94; not taken: a lithographic reprint of 1944 and later). No uids minted.
